ca01_recall._note: The ca01 chain, written once here so --kit regenerates it (wrap review M3). Look up sets {out}: Gwen and Agnieszka stop their needs, Agnieszka walks to the notice (4,3) after 1 s, says her line on arrival, Adaeze answers 4 s after that and sets kit_ca01_done, and Gwen resumes then. The bark conditions never read a global their own mapping writes (stillValid re-runs the condition every 250 ms, so that would cancel the bubble). Every bark carries kit_quiet === true, so a line held across a kiosk reopen is dropped on release (plan 4.5). kit_ca01_t_done is the timer fallback: if the walk is blocked and Agnieszka never arrives, 12 s after {out} it sets kit_ca01_done anyway, and both colleagues resume on it. The two lines in the barks are fixed text that went through five dialogue rounds.
